commits.body:
Qualify the signed comparison used in the generated Lean decisions to remove an ambiguity with the system compare function. Bind the two-cursor reversal theorem to the method loaded from Commons Lang 3.17.0 and its two resolved Math helpers. Lean checks the read and store sequence against a mirror of the entry heap. A physical JVM checked 40,525 normal returns and 3,640 exact exceptions, including the empty-array signed-bounds counterexample.

One capped Lean probe checked the reversal theorem and a separate probe checked an iteration decision after the fix. Job 20261124-041759-bind-the-commons-lang-reversal-theorem-t qualifies the release.
